career_ladder.note: SSC Stenographer Examination recruits personal secretarial staff for senior executive and judicial officials across central ministries, armed forces headquarters (AFHQ), Election Commission, Central Vigilance Commission, and subordinate departments. Secretarial staff follow the Central Secretariat Stenographers' Service (CSSS) and departmental personal staff hierarchies.

exam_scheme.note: SSC Stenographer Grade 'C' & 'D' selection process consists of a single Computer Based Examination (200 questions, 200 marks, 120 minutes, 0.25 negative marking per incorrect answer), followed by a mandatory qualifying Skill Test in Stenography conducted on computer. Final selection and post allotment are determined purely by merit score obtained in the Computer Based Examination.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 4 entry basic pay (₹25,500) for Stenographer Grade 'D' with 58% DA (₹14,790). Stenographer Grade 'C' entrants start at Pay Level 6 (₹35,400 basic, gross ₹60,000 - ₹75,000) or Level 7 (₹44,900 basic in select apex ministries).
official_perks: Transport Allowance (₹3,600 + 58% DA in Class X/Y, ₹1,800 + DA in Class Z)
Annual Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and Children Education Allowance
Defined contribution pension under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC Stenographer attracts 4-6 lakh 12th-pass candidates possessing shorthand proficiencies. The 2024 examination notified 2,006 vacancies (Grade C: 217, Grade D: 1,789). The 2023 drive filled 1,207 vacancies, and 2022 filled 3,960 vacancies.
